roadmap.title: Story first
roadmap.summary: Play Chapters 1–5 and the named missions. Do the house meditation in Chapter 1, scan vehicles and study the world as you travel, take optional missions when offered, never use cheats, and keep a manual save at each chapter start because missions cannot be replayed.

roadmap.title: The 100% checklist and challenges
roadmap.summary: After the story, use Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Earlier progress counts; finish robberies, ranges, drone races, collectibles and counts, noting that 70 of 80 challenges suffice.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and the platinum
roadmap.summary: Finish stranger strands and character finales promptly, mop up feats and money trophies, then complete A Long Road. Vice Got a Price! follows automatically.
